Container.Name: bin4scraper
Container.Overview: Checks the Bin 4 Burger Lounge monthly features page on a schedule and texts the new feature burger to a list of recipients when it changes. Includes a small web UI for recipients, test messages and history.
Container.Requires: Create the appdata folder first and give it to nobody:users -- mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/bin4scraper && chown 99:100 /mnt/user/appdata/bin4scraper

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite database, page snapshots and keys. Must be writable by 99:100.

Config.Name: SMS provider
Config.Description: Console = dry run (messages only appear in the log). Textbelt or Twilio send real texts.

Config.Name: Textbelt test mode
Config.Description: true = Textbelt validates requests but does not send or use quota.

Config.Name: Twilio From number
Config.Description: Your Twilio phone number in +1XXXXXXXXXX format.

Config.Name: Admin phone
Config.Description: Optional. Texted when checks fail several times in a row.

Config.Name: Categories
Config.Description: Comma-separated menu categories to text (e.g. Burger,Dessert) or * for everything.

Config.Name: Schedule
Config.Description: Cron expression for checks (minute hour day month weekday). Messages are only sent when the feature changes.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA time zone used for the schedule.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Username for the web UI (only used when a password is set).

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Optional. Set to require a login for the web UI.
